title: Invertibility of restricted derived-Hom evaluation
statement: The explicitly constructed additive morphism $c_{h,p,F,U}$ of [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map] is an isomorphism for every scheme morphism $h$, etale object $U$, abelian etale sheaf $F$ and degree $p\geq0$, without an affine, nonempty or qcqs hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 03Q8 with Cohomology on Sites Tags 072W, 0BKV and 0D6F; parent proof steps 1-2

proof.text: The free-abelian Yoneda, sheafification and h^*/h_* adjunctions identify Hom from the raw source sheaf with sections over U times_S Y; evaluation at the represented identity gives this identification.

Restriction to the etale pullback preserves injectives by exact extension by zero. Choose a bounded-below injective resolution of F. The K-injective localization bijection computes the raw derived Hom group by homotopy classes to this resolution shifted by p. The sections adjunction identifies these classes with p-th cohomology of its restricted sections complex.

Restriction of the resolution computes derived global sections. On a representing chain map the constructed c sends its class to exactly the corresponding section cocycle. The zero and shift isomorphisms are those used in this computation, so c is bijective and hence an isomorphism; the same computation covers degree zero and the empty pullback.
